full_judgment:
S. K. Sinha J:- This petition for leave to appeal at the instance of the defendant-petitioner arose out of the judgment and order dated 28th May, 2009 of a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 2843 of 2008 discharging the rule and affirming the judgment and decree dated 16th June, 2008 of the learned. Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Gazipur in Title Appeal No. 203 of 1997 affirming those dated 3rd November, 1997 of the learned Additional Assistant Judge, Gazipur in Title Suit No. 32 of 1992. 

 3. The Defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filing written statement contending, inter alia, that one Abed Ali and his wife instituted a suit against him in the Munsif Court at Dhaka, Said Abed Ali managed the plaintiff to institute the instant: suit. The plaintiff is not known to him and he has never seen the plaintiff and no talk for sale was held for transferring the suit land. He did not receive any money towards the consideration of the land and he also did not execute any agreement. Initially the suit was decreed and thereafter on appeal the appellate court remanded the suit. After remand the suit was renumbered as Title Suit No. 32 of 1992. 

 4. After consideration of the evidence on record the learned Additional Assistant Judge, 1st Court, Sadar, Gazipur, by judgment and order dated 3rd November, 1997 decreed the suit. Thereafter the defendant preferred Title Appeal No. 203 of 1997, which was heard by the learned Additional District Judge, 1st Court Gazipur who by the impugned judgment and order dated 16th June, 2008 dismissed the appeal.
